We ran the simulation five times. Each run took about three hours on our lab workstation, mostly because the GPU kept overheating whenever batch sizes exceeded 64. Strangely enough, the third iteration had completely different loss spikes compared to the others. I checked the random seed twice; it was fixed to 42. Maybe some non-deterministic CUDA kernel was acting up, but we didn't have enough time to debug low-level driver calls before Friday's deadline.
